readme.run: Register a moving image to a fixed image
notes: Runs niimath -allineate from the same WebAssembly build as the web app and
writes its download, <moving>_registered.nii, on the fixed grid.
Add --robust-fov to crop the neck first. No network connection is required.
Input is NIfTI only: convert DICOM with dcm2niix first, or use the web app.
Native niimath (container vnmd/niimath) runs the same method; its output
differs from this build's by floating-point rounding. Please cite:
Cox RW. AFNI 3dAllineate: affine image registration [Computer software].
